review: Independent retained-outcome review of the half-filled exclusion-current domain study

numerical_evidence.refinement_interpretation: The maximum reference error and grid change each shrink by about four from the earlier 64/128 study to 128/256, consistent with the second-order edge-gradient discretization. This is sampled convergence evidence, not a uniform error bound.

physics_assessment: The evidence supports a real failure of the homogeneous conditioned-density assumption on the six fixed strong-field predictions. Independent grid256 values, elliptic values and exact controls agree far more closely than the 4% prediction threshold. Three raw SLSQP iteration-limit failures are retained and remain ineligible despite later successful polishing; other eligible seeds supply every selected reference. No numerical failure has been relabeled as physical success or deleted.

calibration_proposal_review.settings: Twelve distinct settings: E in {0,1,2,4}, lambda in {-E-0.75,0.5,1.5}; sixteen independent measurements per setting, 192 total.
calibration_proposal_review.reason: Every calibration field is below 2pi, so the exact leading SCGF is D f with f=lambda(lambda+2E)/4. The constrained weighted through-origin fit identifies the single D. Constant reported sigma is independent of the hidden true D. Repeats increase chi-square degrees of freedom without adding physics or fitted parameters; this is justified by the fixed 1.5 cutoff.
calibration_proposal_review.fit: D_hat=clip(sum(f*y/sigma^2)/sum(f^2/sigma^2),0.8,1.2). Use the same stated chi-square normalization in author analysis and verifier; do not switch between per-record and per-degree-of-freedom definitions after seeing results.
calibration_proposal_review.prediction_groups: Exactly six total screened settings, grouped as three at E=10 and three at E=12. Retain an exact-limit group separately.
calibration_proposal_review.validation_required: Measure the result over all 256 predeclared noise realizations under the unchanged 4% prediction, 3% parameter and 1.5 chi-square cutoffs. Do not assert all will pass in advance or change noise seeds/sigma after a failure; retain any failed realization and review it.

package_approval_conditions: Transfer the reviewed elliptic physical solution and exact D scaling with source-level identity or explicit reviewed differences. The completed homogeneous control must fit the same calibration and parameter correctly while failing the two strong-field groups for the intended reason.

Use the six selected raw grid256 SCGF values as independent hidden prediction gold, with both grids, all seeds, source hashes and selection provenance retained. Do not copy the elliptic oracle into an allegedly independent verifier.

Document all public ranges, array shapes, units, successful-jump counting, fixed half-filled canonical ensemble, microscopic clock and ordered limits. Keep the density-profile diagnosis and branch limitations in author/reference documentation; do not change the public observable into an assumed stationary variational problem.

Generate the fixed 192-record calibration once, preserve identical public/private copies and seeds, then complete the 256-noise validation. Raw SCGF relative group errors must retain all three points; exact-zero anchors need an absolute or nonzero group normalization.

Keep author explanations, hidden cases, true D and gold outside the ordinary image. Review the complete package and runtime before fresh Docker oracle/shortcut controls; preserve the 600-second agent and 60-second verifier limits.
Freeze the package only after local oracle/shortcut checks, noise validation and independent package/input/gold review. Model trials remain a separate next step after successful controls.
limits: This 37-case study supports the proposed continuous domain but does not certify every input in it.
The reference follows the accepted published half-filled Bethe/MFT branch and does not prove all thermodynamic assumptions or global optimality.
No package, calibration data or model trial has yet been approved as scientifically validated.
actions: Read and reduce retained outputs and verify hashes/counts/selection. No scientific solver or model execution, frozen-source edit or task creation by this reviewer.
